title: Vietnam Odyssey | A Tale of Majestic Bays and Tropical Shores
highlights: Get delighted by the magical land of the Ninh Binh province which has an amazing natural landscape with rivers, rice paddies and limestone caves.
Explore Vietnam with it's vibrant cities of Hanoi, Da Nang, Phu Quoc, and Ho Chi Minh, each offering a unique blend of history, culture, and modern charm.
Discover Halong Bay, a UNESCO World Heritage site, and marvel at its breathtaking limestone karsts and emerald waters.
Walk across Da Nang’s Golden Hand Bridge, an amazing structure held up by giant stone hands, offering stunning views of the surrounding landscape.
Glide through the serene Tam Coc caves by boat, known as the "Halong Bay on Land," and marvel at the dramatic limestone formations and lush rice paddies.
overview:
About the Tour:
Discover the wonders of Vietnam as you enjoy your cruise through the ocean, interact with locals in the countryside, go island hopping, visit the historical monuments, try Vietnamese cuisine, or indulge in a shopping spree at the traditional markets, giving you a number of opportunities to have once in a lifetime.
Home to eclectic nature in the form of massive cliffs, green grasslands, and rich history and culture, Vietnam has grown into one of the best locations to visit in South East Asia. Offering you a chance to experience the best of nature, the 10 days Vietnam package will take you to three significant cities in Vietnam, where you will get an opportunity to visit the iconic landmarks and indulge in magical and fun-filled experiences.

know_before_you_go: Visa assistance will be provided however charges are not included.
Please do not litter and keep the destination clean.
Please note that prices are dynamic and may change in the peak season and on blackout dates.

As per Indian Govt. Rules, a Tax Collection at Source (TCS) of 5% for Foreign Remittance shall be paid additionally that you can claim while filing the income tax returns. Consult a tax advisor/consultant for further information.

One can apply for E-Visa online or can get an on arrival Visa stamped while completing the immigration process at the airport. The tourist visa for Indian Tourist is valid for 30 days and can cost an approx of INR 3000/- to 4500/-.
Travel Insurance is recommended and charges are not included
Please depart on suggested timings to avoid any inconvenience

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Hanoi | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Vietnam! Upon arrival at the airport, you'll be transferred to your hotel. Once you check in, enjoy the rest of the day at your leisure. You can visit the stunning St. Joseph's Cathedral, an iconic landmark with beautiful French Gothic architecture. You can also visit Hoan Kiem Lake and explore Ngoc Son Temple, a picturesque temple situated on a small island in the middle of the lake. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day Trip to Ninh Binh
days.desc: Today, you'll board the transfer to Ninh Binh. Here, you'll explore the ancient capital and visit the historic temples dedicated to King Dinh and King Le. Afterward, embark on a picturesque boat ride from Hoa Lu to Tam Coc, gliding through scenic waterways framed by towering limestone karsts. Later, enjoy a peaceful cycling adventure along quiet village roads from Tam Coc to Bich Dong Pagoda, where you can explore the cluster of ancient cave temples. Lastly, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Halong Bay | Overnight Cruise
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and get driven to Tuan Chau Port in Halong Bay City. Upon arrival, board your traditional cruise and check into your room. As the cruise sets sail into Halong Bay, enjoy a delicious lunch featuring fresh seafood and local delicacies while admiring the stunning views of caves, Duck Islet and many more. You’ll also have the opportunity to participate in optional activities such as swimming and kayaking. Afterwards, return to your room for an overnight stay.

Halong Bay Overnight Cruise
items.desc:
Embark on your overnight cruise in Halong Bay and be greeted with a delightful lunch and refreshing drinks.
Take in the stunning views of the bay, featuring its captivating caves, sandy beaches, picturesque floating fishing villages, Duck Islet, and distinctive rock formations.
Participate in a chef-led cooking class to discover traditional dishes and local flavors.
Enjoy an overnight stay at the cruise.

days.title: Halong Bay to Da Nang via Hanoi
days.desc: Wake up early to enjoy the stunning sunrise views from your deck. Afterward, participate in a Tai Chi session on the sundeck or take a tour of Surprise Cave to explore its impressive natural beauty. Later, check out from the cruise and board the transfer from Tuan Chau Harbor to Hanoi Airport. Catch your flight to Da Nang, and upon arrival, check into your hotel for an overnight stay.

items.title: Halong Bay Cruise
items.desc:
Start your day with a Tai Chi class on the sundeck, enjoying this traditional Chinese exercise. 
Then, explore the amazing sights of Halong Bay, known as one of the seven new wonders of the world. 
Take a small boat to visit Surprise Cave (Sung Sot), the largest cave in Halong Bay, which covers 12,000 square meters, and admire its stunning natural beauty. 
After your cave adventure, return to the cruise and head back to Tuan Chau Harbor.

days.title: Ba Na Hill Day Tour
days.desc: Today, you’ll be driven to Ba Na Hills, where you’ll start your adventure with a cable car ride from Suoi Mo Station to Marseille Station. Upon arrival, admire the Golden Hand Bridge, which offers stunning 360° views of the surrounding landscape. Explore the French Village, where you can experience a blend of French-style architecture and cuisine. Next, take a leisurely stroll around Linh Ung Pagoda and visit the historic Debay Wine Cellar. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

days.title: Da Nang to Phu Quoc | Day at Lesiure
days.desc: In the morning, check out from the hotel and transfer to Da Nang Airport for your flight to Phu Quoc. Upon arrival, you’ll be driven to your hotel for check-in. Spend the rest of the day at your leisure, exploring options such as Phu Quoc National Park or visiting the nearby Ham Ninh Fishing Village. In the evening, you can relax by the beautiful Long Beach, enjoying the serene sunset. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Day at Leisure in Phu Quoc
days.desc: This day is yours to explore the enchanting emerald island of Phú Quốc on your own. You can rent a motorbike and visit Suoi Tranh Waterfall for a refreshing swim amidst beautiful natural surroundings. Next, head to Vinpearl Safari, where you can see a diverse range of wild animals in their natural habitat. You can also explore VinWonders for its thrilling water slides and other attractions. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Fly to Ho Chi Minh | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Today, you'll check out from the hotel and board the transfer to Phu Quoc Airport for your flight to Ho Chi Minh City. Once you arrive, get driven to your hotel. Check in and spend the rest of the day leisure. You can visit the Independence Palace and War Remnants Museum. At the museum, you'll get a glimpse into the impacts of the Vietnam War through exhibits and photographs. Later, return to the hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Mekong Delta Tour
days.desc: In the morning, you’ll be driven to My Tho, known as the floating market city of Vietnam. Start your tour with a visit to the Vinh Trang Pagoda, a stunning example of ornate Vietnamese architecture. Next, enjoy a relaxing boat ride along the village canals, where you can observe the traditional river life and vibrant local markets. Stop by Tortoise Islet, famous for its picturesque landscapes and cultural significance. Later, get driven back to the hotel for an overnight stay.
